segments.name: American Southern
segments.description: Property and casualty operations providing tailored commercial automobile, liability, surety and inland marine coverage to governments, municipalities and fleets.
segments.evidence: American Southern comprises the Company's property and casualty operations and its primary product lines are as follows: Commercial Automobile Insurance policies provide bodily injury and/or property damage liability coverage, uninsured motorist coverage and physical damage coverage for commercial accounts.

segments.name: Bankers Fidelity
segments.description: Life and health operations offering individual and group life insurance, Medicare Supplement and supplemental accident and health products to policyholders.
segments.evidence: Bankers Fidelity comprises the life and health operations of the Company and offers a variety of life and supplemental health products.

revenueModel.text: Policyholders pay premiums to the Company's insurance subsidiaries for property and casualty and life and health insurance coverage.
